description.value:
Thanks to your ties to House Ghallanda, you grew up used to comfort, lively conversation, fine drink, and delicious food. You might be a witty, charming scion who loves nothing more than a pleasant evening by a warm hearth, or a schemer who uses trust and friendship to bend others to your will. You might take up adventuring to learn the cuisines of other cultures and eras, widen your circle of useful contacts, or earn enough to open your own inn.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.s9uNMvT2QYghCPLW]{Mark of Hospitality}

Skill Proficiencies: Insight and Persuasion

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCooksUtens]{Cook's Utensils}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCooksUtens]{Cook's Utensils}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPotIron0000]{Iron Pot}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLamp0000000]{Lamp}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Oil} (5 flasks), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPerfume0000]{Perfume}, 26 GP; or (B) 50 GP
